# IPBulucu — public IP and network tools

> Public IP lookup, approximate geolocation, DNS, Whois and network diagnostics. Results depend on the endpoint and its upstream provider. Read errors and limitations before using any result.

## Documentation
- [API schema](https://ipbulucu.org/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 schema.
- [Developer guide](https://ipbulucu.org/api-dokumantasyon/)
- [Privacy and data processing](https://ipbulucu.org/en/privacy-policy/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/codeonthetable/ipbulucu.org)

## Public IP
GET https://ipbulucu.org/api/ip?format=json
Optional `ip`: public IPv4, IPv6 or resolvable domain. Omit it to detect the requesting connection's public IP. A server-side AI tool sees its own server's egress IP, not the user's device IP.

Response includes `success`, `ip`, `version`, `geoStatus`, `source`, `checkedAt`, approximate location, ISP and ASN. Location fields are nullable. `geoStatus=unavailable` means the IP is known but location data could not be obtained. `success=true` does not mean every field was measured.

This endpoint does not measure VPN, proxy, Tor, CGNAT, line speed, identity, reputation, open ports or game latency. Legacy fields for these values are null or empty arrays. Never treat null as safe or zero risk. IP geolocation is not a street address or a person's identity.

Use `format=text` for plain text. HTTP 400 is invalid input; 405 is an unsupported method. Retry transient failures with a bounded delay. No uptime, unlimited capacity or latency guarantee is made.

## Other endpoints
- GET /api/whois?domain=example.com — domain registration data; upstream coverage varies.
- GET /api/dns?domain=example.com — A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME and SOA via Google DoH.
- GET /api/port?host=YOUR_AUTHORIZED_HOST&port=443 — TCP connection from the service server. A failed connection is not proof of a permanently closed port. Use only targets you own or are authorized to test.

IP monitoring on the website runs only while its tab remains open. Server-side alerts and webhook delivery are not available.

## Limits
Non-IP diagnostic APIs share a 120 requests/minute budget. Port checks additionally share 20 requests/minute, at most 16 ports and six seconds per call. HTTP 429 includes Retry-After. Geolocation has a shared 850 provider calls/day budget; when unavailable, IP discovery still works and geoStatus is unavailable. Plain text IP requests do not consume the geolocation budget. These are current service safeguards, not a capacity guarantee.

## Measurement
Clients may send `X-IPBulucu-Client` (web, chrome-extension, node-sdk, python-sdk) and `X-IPBulucu-Action` (auto or user). These are self-declared categories, not proof of a human or AI identity. Optional server counters store daily aggregate counts without query values or raw IP addresses. Website analytics and server request counts are separate measures.
